2024 total loan amount compared to 2023 total, percentage growth
attempts.response:
WITH yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE)) AS loan_year,
    SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_loan_amount
  FROM shg_loan_register
  WHERE "Disbursement Date" LIKE '2023%' OR "Disbursement Date" LIKE '2024%'
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE))
)
SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN loan_year = 2024 THEN total_loan_amount END) - SUM(CASE WHEN loan_year = 2023 THEN total_loan_amount END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN loan_year = 2023 THEN total_loan_amount END), 0) AS percentage_growth
FROM yearly_totals;
